integrity: Universal claim supported by the explicit cyclic Green-function proof. An independent standard-library exact-rational checker passed 33 normal-matrix cases and boundary tests. Finite diagnostics are not a proof of arbitrary parameters. Independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
limitations: Exact only for real degree-one periodic splines on a uniform circular grid with two equal-weight symmetric samples per cell; no claim for arbitrary quadrature, nonuniform meshes or higher degree. Older 1998 print paper has no verified exact first-public day: 2009-04-17 is its explicitly documented publisher online release. Priority remains qualified for unindexed literature.
title: Sharp parity law for two-point discrete projection onto periodic linear splines
